description.value: Osteria Otto is a dinner-focused Italian restaurant on East 8th Avenue in Vancouver that merges seasonal Italian cooking and Pacific Northwest produce with the intimate atmosphere of a Japanese kissa listening bar, complete with curated vinyl and hi-fi sound. The menu leans into ingredient-forward, sharing-style dishes that reflect both Italian culinary clarity and the West Coast landscape. A touring cyclist looking for a full sit-down evening meal in a warm, unhurried setting will find it a distinctive stop.
